name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately describes a per-tick state machine for the generic single-target summon-spell animation. No address residue (the 0x26528 is only in the comment as a location tag, not in the name).
purpose: Per-tick state machine that drives the generic single-target summon-spell animation; dispatch-table entry #2.
logic_summary: Reads the caster's runtime_char.bTeam (offset 6) to derive is_enemy (bTeam==0). Switches on state_code over a private phase/aux/tick triple (globals at 0x53F7E/0x53F7F/0x53F80). state 0 resets the triple and returns 0x1D; state 3 sets phase=0x10 returns 0xC; state 6 plays an SFX chime, sets phase=0xA, returns 0xA. States 1/7 (ally only) optionally snap phase 0xA->0xF on entry (state 1) then advance the frame-paced sprite tick via fd2_tick_sprite_animation_step. States 2/8 play an SFX click when phase==7, run the paced tick only for enemies (with the same 0xA->0xF snap on state 2), and blit frame 0x10 once phase reaches 0x10. State 4 (ally only) blits frame 0xF one row above origin. State 5 (enemy adds a frame-0xF blit one row higher) always blits the current phase frame one row above origin, increments phase, plays the finish SFX and returns 1 (done) at phase 0x11, and wraps phase back to 0x10 at 0x12. All other states return 0.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_tick_summon_spell_animation_state(int caster_unit_id, int sprite_handle, int origin_y, int row_stride, char state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Index of the casting unit into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; used to read bTeam (offset 6) for the is_enemy branch.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite atlas handle passed to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite / fd2_tick_sprite_animation_step.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Base Y origin for the blits; several states render at origin_y +/- 1 - row_stride.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Per-row pixel/byte stride used both as a vertical offset and as the blit row stride argument.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Animation phase selector dispatched by the switch (0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8).

returns.semantics: Frame-hold / status code consumed by the caller's dispatch loop: 0x1D (state 0 init delay), 0xC (state 3), 0xA (state 6), 1 = animation finished (state 5 at phase 0x11), 0 otherwise.

comment_original_issue: Original comment block stated the conclusion as a history/correction narrative ('Plate comment had incorrect is_enemy condition ... assembly verified: NON-enemy does the tick/blit'), which is process flux rather than a final-state description.
notes: is_enemy semantics: Ghidra runtime_char (80 bytes) has bTeam at offset 6; source reads pChar[6], matching the binary. Decompiler bVar1 = bTeam==0 is identical to source is_enemy. Decompilation and source are behaviorally identical across all states (states {1,7}/4 = ally/non-enemy path; states {2,8} enemy-only tick), so no equivalence issue. Sole xref is the dispatch table at 0x523C1 (table base 0x523B9, entry index 2). Plate already states the corrected NOT-is_enemy conditions, so it stays as-is. No logic changed.
